scripts.dev:driver: bun run with-env env APP_VARIANT=development EXPO_PUBLIC_DRIVER_PLATFORM_MODE=true EXPO_PUBLIC_SENTRY_ENABLED=false node ./scripts/run-expo-cli.cjs start --go --port ${GND_DRIVER_MOBILE_PORT:-3013}
scripts.eas-build:dev: BUN_AUTO_INSTALL=0 bun run with-env env EXPO_PUBLIC_SENTRY_ENABLED=false EXPO_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DEBUG=false EXPO_PUBLIC_SENTRY_SMOKE_TEST=false SENTRY_DISABLE_AUTO_UPLOAD=true eas build --profile development --platform android
scripts.eas-build:preview: BUN_AUTO_INSTALL=0 bun run with-env:prod env -u EXPO_PUBLIC_EMAIL -u EXPO_PUBLIC_TOK EXPO_PUBLIC_SENTRY_ENABLED=false EXPO_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DEBUG=false EXPO_PUBLIC_SENTRY_SMOKE_TEST=false SENTRY_DISABLE_AUTO_UPLOAD=true EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1 eas build -p android --profile preview
scripts.eas-build:prod: BUN_AUTO_INSTALL=0 bun run with-env:prod env -u EXPO_PUBLIC_EMAIL -u EXPO_PUBLIC_TOK EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1 eas build -p android --profile production
scripts.eas-build:android:play: bun ./scripts/android-play-build-gate.ts && bun run android:play:check && BUN_AUTO_INSTALL=0 bun run with-env:prod env -u EXPO_PUBLIC_EMAIL -u EXPO_PUBLIC_TOK EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1 eas build -p android --profile play
scripts.android:play:check: BUN_AUTO_INSTALL=0 bun run with-env:prod env -u EXPO_PUBLIC_EMAIL -u EXPO_PUBLIC_TOK EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1 node ./scripts/run-android-play-preflight.cjs
scripts.eas-build:ios:prod: bun ./scripts/ios-build-gate.ts && bun run ios:release:preflight && BUN_AUTO_INSTALL=0 bun run with-env:prod env -u EXPO_PUBLIC_EMAIL -u EXPO_PUBLIC_TOK EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1 eas build -p ios --profile production
scripts.eas-build-submit:ios:prod: bun ./scripts/ios-auto-submit-gate.ts && bun run ios:release:preflight && BUN_AUTO_INSTALL=0 bun run with-env:prod env -u EXPO_PUBLIC_EMAIL -u EXPO_PUBLIC_TOK EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1 eas build -p ios --profile production --auto-submit-with-profile production
scripts.ios:release:preflight: BUN_AUTO_INSTALL=0 bun run with-env:prod env -u EXPO_PUBLIC_EMAIL -u EXPO_PUBLIC_TOK APP_VARIANT=production GND_IOS_PUBLIC_RELEASE=true EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1 node ./scripts/run-ios-release-preflight.cjs
